svg.title: From computational drug prioritization to experimental response
svg.desc: The computational portion of the published graphical abstract compares resistant and sensitive cell lines and integrates multi-omic features, NFE2L2-associated programs and drug–gene relationships. Rosiglitazone was selected for experimental testing. Unchanged published panels G–J show OE19 and PANC-1 vincristine responses with and without rosiglitazone pretreatment. The abstract's schematic heatmap is omitted. Mersich, Blagg and Ali, iScience 29, 114293, CC BY 4.0.
